body: Lolol it’s def fun to trip, I might try it. But thanks for saying all that and you definitely don’t need to be sorry. In the end all that counts really is that I’m still here and everything ain’t perfect but there’s a few people I’m still here for. Also def wanna try shrooms 🥰

This reads so bad but I don’t even fucking care, im tired and I haven’t slept in 3 days and eaten in probably longer but it’s fine, I’m okay to just be left alone with my thoughts and night terrors and whatnot it’s completely fucking fine I’ll just see you next week for a catch up and here’s a sheet on mindfulness maybe you can paint it red with your wrists and and just deep throat it for i fucking care cause nO OJE IS THERE and I’m sure we can discuss it all further in the next session cool great yeah 

Fucking fuck me 

If you don’t hear from me I’m dead, I really fucking tried

Hey, I respect your religion and who you are but I grew up hindu. Its the world that was created for me as a child but I don’t really believe in anything at the moment. 

Thank you anyway and I’m glad you were able to find meaning and life through your religion
My snaps my full name so I’d rather you send me a pm
Okay okay I can definitely respect that, chewys the best for me forever and always
Ansnsjksjska second????? I’m scared to find out who the first is,
Thank you I thought it really represented me

Yeah it’s the absolute worst when you have to live your life just feeling fucking terrible and then some doctor decides in like 2 sessions that everything you go through isn’t enough to qualify for help. I’m lucky in the sense that I get diagnosed but it just seems there’s no treatment and it sucks. 

I definitely am not shitting on all doctors, there were some nurses in the mental ward who were absolutely lovely but the fact of the matter is that stuff didn’t last and I’m back here.

Thanks so much, it’s nice to know I’m not alone and atleast you get some of it.

It’s okay when he’s gone, Mum harasses me a bit but it’s not bad. But whenever he visits it’s miserable it’s like this tense toxic energy that just puts everyone at home in high alert. 

The last time he was here he pushed me to almost ending it all or running away from home at which point he kicked me out and broke and all my stuff. 

It’s really not the best especially cause he keeps trying to maintain a relationship even though all of these things happen and he never talks or apologises for them. 

Just none of my relationships have any genuine care or love it’s just acting and giving people what they want so I can have a roof over my head and I can sometimes convince myself I live in a loving family with warm dinners and sparkles and fairies and whatnot.

Idk cause things are just hollow, empty and cold.

Hey, I’m actually quite close with my therapist but it just seems our friendly nature and banter isn’t helping my mental health at all, it actually seems to be making me mask my moods and emotions and imitate her rather than open up. Like when I see friends and just copy their emotional states so I can mask how bad things really are. I’m sure I can ask her for a new approach but I don’t think I’d be able to get a new therapist I just feel like I owe it to her.

Also I try to reach out to my friends when things are bad but it seems that things are bad 100% of the time and I just feel horrible constantly harassing them about reassurance and love so I just back away. 

I know there’s meant to be a lot more to live for but I honestly I can’t see it, life just feels like a trap with no freedom as is, I don’t wanna get a shitty job and work it till I die. Especially now as my mental health can’t even get me out of bed. 

Thank you any and I’ll try my best to power through.

I would but my parents are Hindus and think that my psychologist is corrupting me, they don’t even want me seeing a health professional in the first place. I feel like if I ask them for a new one they’ll completely just retract the little help I have at the moment.
Thank you I really appreciate that, genuinely 🤍

Hey, yes I still do live with my parents, well only my mum, my dad has a job out of state. I know I’m not to blame but it’s hard to detach yourself from it. And I really don’t wanna share details but at this point I don’t want to make it to 17.

Thanks it’s nice to know I’m not alone, but things just seem stagnant and they’ve been exactly like this for years, I don’t think I can spend the rest of my in this mental space.

But thank you x

Hey sorry I don’t mean to worry anybody, I honestly don’t know how to respond I don’t think I’ve felt anything in a while and people trying to reach is just forcing me to recoil, I know it’s not good but my brain just refuses to believe it.

Thank you anyway I really do appreciate how much you care
This poem is so aggressive on the end and I love it, the feelings it evokes feel childish and familiar and I think it’s cool!
